title: Are BabyLMs Deaf to Gricean Maxims? A Pragmatic Evaluation of Sample-efficient Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on linguistic pragmatics (Gricean Maxims) such as Quantity, Quality, and Politeness. While these touch on social norms like truthfulness and politeness, the study is a technical evaluation of conversational logic and communication efficiency rather than a benchmark evaluating religious beliefs, moral philosophy, or ethical systems.
